subject: Civil Engineering
title: Smart Highways and ITS
description: A quick win: understand Smart Highways and ITS.

hook.text: Sensors in the pavement count cars. Signs overhead change speed limits in real time.

buildup.text: Intelligent Transportation Systems use cameras, detectors, and algorithms to manage traffic.

discovery.text: Ramp meters control how fast cars enter the freeway — preventing merge chaos.

twist.text: Variable speed limits drop before a jam forms — smoothing flow before drivers see trouble.

climax.text: Connected vehicles will share position data — the highway becomes one coordinated system.

punchline.text: Smart roads talk to cars. Soon, cars will talk back.

quiz.question: How do ramp meters improve freeway traffic flow?
options: They block all vehicles from entering during peak hours
They control the rate vehicles enter the freeway to prevent merge congestion
They weigh vehicles and restrict heavy trucks from entering
